part: A1 restoration criterion for a fixed-number bath
labels: [D] derived, [C] computed, [Q] quoted, [E] estimate, [P] preparation datum
comparison relic_yield mu_N=0 [Q]: relic_yield: T_SM >= 2.04-2.10e6 GeV (v/TeV)^(4/3); v_relic route B with the strict Y: 2.066-2.088e6 GeV

Hubble-damped criterion [D].statement: In RD with conserved (Y_N, eps) and a relativistic bath, Pi_phi = A H with A constant. The zero mode responds (Pi - lphi v^2 > H^2 at some time) iff A > 2 sqrt(lphi) v = 200 GeV, i.e. iff T_SM,end < T(H = sqrt(lphi) v/2), and the bath existed at H = A/2.
Hubble-damped criterion [D].memory [E]: cold +v start, no damping: coherent amplitude at the exit ~ 1.7 v sqrt(lphi) v/A; below the vacuum soft-mode level 0.11 sqrt(lphi) v needs A > ~15 v, i.e. T_SM,end < 6.89e+08 GeV

overpopulated bath [D, E].gas bound [D]: eps < eps_th(Y_N): kinetic equilibrium is a mu = m_min gas at the energy temperature plus a condensate; the gas alone gives Pi >= Pi_th(T_E), so restoration lasts at least to T_SM = T_c(1)/xi_E, xi_E = (eps g*/g_h)^(1/4).

uncharged X-condensate placeholder [E].note: cold, uncharged, linearly oscillating X condensate at phi=0 with g_X^2<q1^2> = lphi v^2; unstable to fragmentation; not a computed bound

headline.T_SM,end scaling, MB limit: T_SM,end = sqrt(lphi v^2 eps/(K Y_N^2)), K = 1.1730 -> 92.33 GeV sqrt(eps)/Y_N (v/TeV)
